name: Cascade Biotech Substrate Containment Suit
description:
A specialized containment suit designed for handling active substrate materials that exhibit unpredictable biological behavior. The suit's exterior is coated with a substrate-repellent compound that prevents biological agents from bonding to the surface. Internal monitoring systems alert the wearer if any substrate material penetrates the barrier.

Unique to Synthesis Collective and Cascade Biotech facilities where substrate research pushes into territory that conventional hazmat equipment can't address. The suit is designed for threats that are alive, adaptive, and actively trying to find a way through.
functionality: Active substrate containment, breach detection, bio-bonding prevention
what_it_says: Whatever you're handling is alive, it wants out, and this suit is the argument against that.
story_hooks: A Substrate Containment Suit's breach-detection system activates inside a storage room that should contain no active substrate — something in that room has woken up.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, full-body containment suit with an almost liquid appearance. The silhouette is streamlined and deliberate—neither bulky nor form-fitting, but engineered for maximum mobility within a hazardous envelope. The suit reads as high-tier biotech protective wear: clinical, intimidating, and purposeful. Chrome accent panels run along the spine and shoulders, housing sensor arrays.
physical_description.fit: Compression-adjacent but not restrictive—tailored for precise movement during delicate substrate handling. The torso sits snug against the body, while the limbs allow articulation without excess fabric. The hood seals at the neck with a reinforced collar that integrates with an external respirator interface.
physical_description.primary_material: Proprietary substrate-repellent polymeric composite with a semi-translucent outer membrane. The base layer is ballistic-grade synthetic weave. Under magnification, the surface has a subtle iridescent sheen from the biological-resistant coating.
physical_description.texture: Smooth and almost slick to the touch, with fine micro-etching across the exterior that prevents substrate adhesion. Seams are reinforced and thermally sealed. Internal lining is soft, moisture-wicking treated synth-cotton. Embossed warning striping along joints.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray as the primary color, with translucent frost-white panels at the chest and forearms (monitoring zones). Bioluminescent green accent lines trace the spinal column and wrist cuffs, cycling faintly to indicate system status. Cascade Biotech's stylized 'CB' logo in chrome on the left shoulder.
physical_description.closures: Full-length magnetic-lock zipper running from the groin to the nape of the neck, sealed with friction-fit security tabs. Wrist and ankle cuffs feature triple-latch compression seals. The hood integrates magnetically with the suit collar.
distinctive_features: Integrated biometric sensor array along the spine—faintly visible beneath the translucent sections
Transparent polymer observation panels on chest and forearms for real-time substrate monitoring
Reinforced palm and heel contact points for grip
Built-in pressure gauge readout at the wrist (glowing numeric display)
Substrate intrusion alarm system—subtle but functional indicator lights at the collar
Double-sealed joint reinforcement at elbows, knees, and shoulders
Cascade Biotech certification hologram embedded in the right chest panel
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 corporate. This suit is expensive, exclusive, and signals access to cutting-edge biotech infrastructure.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by research specialists, substrate handlers, and biotech engineers within corporate or collective facilities. Signals expertise, danger clearance, and proximity to experimental biological work. Wearing this outside authorized zones would trigger immediate security alerts.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine or meticulously maintained. Cascade Biotech facilities enforce strict decontamination protocols. Any visible wear (micro-scratches, seal degradation) indicates imminent suit retirement. Most suits are replaced rather than repaired.
